title: Elimination Game
description:
Start with the integers from `1` through `n` in increasing order. Repeatedly remove the first number and every other number from left to right, then remove the last number and every other number from right to left, alternating directions until one number remains. Return that number.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 9
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^9`
